message.content:
### Overall Layout & Structure  
The page follows a **full-width, vertical layout** with a clear hierarchy: a hero section (background image + text) → navigation/filter bar → grid of food/dining images. The design is centered and balanced, with consistent spacing between sections.  


### Hero Section (Top)  
- **Background**: A blurred, high-quality image of a restaurant interior (tables, chairs, ambient lighting) with a shallow depth of field, creating a warm, upscale dining atmosphere.  
- **Text Elements**:  
  - Top-left: Small, light gray text: *"На главную"* (link, likely "To homepage") and *"Главная — Галерея"* (breadcrumb: "Home — Gallery").  
  - Center: Large, elegant serif font (gold/cream color) for the heading *"Наши работы"* ("Our Works"), which stands out against the dark background.  
- **Visual Accent**: A subtle animation of salt/sugar sprinkling (white particles) adds a dynamic, culinary touch.  


### Filter Navigation Bar  
- **Position**: Below the hero, centered.  
- **Buttons**: 6 rounded rectangular buttons with dark backgrounds (black/charcoal) and light text (white/gray). The first button, *"Все"* ("All"), is highlighted with a light gold background and darker text, indicating it’s the active filter.  
- **Spacing**: Buttons are evenly spaced with moderate padding (horizontal/vertical) for easy tapping/clicking.  


### Image Grid (Main Content)  
- **Layout**: 3-column grid (responsive, likely adjusts to 2 or 1 column on smaller screens) with rounded corners on each image.  
- **Images**:  
  - **First Image**: A spread of diverse dishes (burgers, bread, pastries, fruit) in a restaurant setting (blurred background of diners/tables).  
  - **Second Image**: A lavish dessert display (macarons, tarts, berries, chocolate treats) on tiered stands.  
  - **Third Image**: A close-up of a grilled steak with herbs, vegetables, and sauce (highly detailed, appetizing).  
- **Spacing**: Consistent margin between images (e.g., 1–2rem) and padding inside the grid container, ensuring visual breathing room.  


### Colors  
- **Background**: Dark (black/charcoal) for the main content area, contrasting with the bright, vibrant food images.  
- **Text**: Light (white/gray) for navigation/breadcrumbs; gold/cream for the main heading (elegant, attention-grabbing).  
- **Buttons**: Dark backgrounds with light text (except the active "Все" button, which uses a light gold background for emphasis).  


### Typography  
- **Font Style**: Serif font for the main heading (*"Наши работы"*) to convey sophistication; sans-serif for navigation/filter text (clean, modern).  
- **Hierarchy**: Clear size contrast (large heading vs. small navigation text) ensures readability.  


### Images  
- **Quality**: High-resolution, well-composed, and visually appealing (sharp focus on food, vibrant colors).  
- **Consistency**: All images follow a similar style (close-up/medium shots of food/dining, warm tones) to maintain a cohesive brand identity.  


### Visual Issues (None Observed)  
- No overlapping elements, broken images, or readability problems.  
- Spacing is balanced (no overcrowding or excessive whitespace).  
- Color contrast is sufficient (text on dark backgrounds is legible; images pop against the dark backdrop).  


### Summary  
The design is **upscale, cohesive, and user-friendly**, with a clear focus on showcasing culinary/dining work. The layout guides the eye from the hero to the filter bar to the image grid, using color, typography, and spacing to create a polished, professional look.
